(45)༄༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos lnga'i rtsa tshig 'khrul med rdo rje'i rgya mdud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (45)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos lnga'i rtsa tshig 'khrul med rdo rje'i rgya mdud ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(46)༄༅// rin chen rnam bdun gser gyi phreng*// 'dzin mdzad bla ma'i gsang ba gsum// mos gus snying gi chu skyes la// brtan bzhugs sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs// sngon cad lugs 'dir sgom don ngag tu brjod pa'i srol mi 'dug kyang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis nā ro'i chos drug chen mo'i rtsa tshig mdzad pas blo dman la gsal thebs sla ba'i phan pa chen po'i rgyun srol 'dug pa ltar/ lugs 'di'i chos drug la'ang de ltar med ka med du 'dug ces nyams len mkhan rnams nas snga rjes nan gyis bskul ba ltar 'bri ba la/ rin chen rnam bdun brgyud par bcas pa dang*/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pas bka'i gnang ba stsal zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de la sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don rnams gzhan du bkod zin/ 'dir gser chos dang po rtsa ba ni gu chos drug rje btsun chen po'i khrid yig tu/ rgyas pa dmigs skor drug cu rtsa bdun/ 'bring po bcu bdun/ bsdus pa stan gcig mar drug tu gsungs pa las/ 'dir nyams khrid rgyas pa la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas shing*/ de las dngos gzhi sgom pa'i skabs su med ka med rnams sdom du bkod pa'i thog mar gtum mo bde drod rang (47)'bar gyi sngon 'gro lus gnad me'i stong ra gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar// spyan gsum skra grol rus pa'i rgyan chas spras// rdo rje thod khrag bsnams shing me dpung dbus// pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang bzhugs// dar dmar gur phub lta bu'i stong ra'i nang*// 'od dmar drod kyi rang bzhin khyab pa'o/ /zhes pas lus kyi stong ra nan tu gsal 'debs pa ni 'og dngos gzhi la'ang mtshungs so// me rgod dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i mdun rgyab mkhal khung gnyis// me gong zlum po dmar la reg bya tsha// lcags bsregs gong bu dang mtshungs bzhi sgom gsal// drag rlung sbyor bas me gong bzhi po 'thab// me stag chems chem lus kyi nang khyab pas// stod smad tsha drod 'ur re 'bar bar 'gyur/

/dngos gzhi gtum mo zas za la/ rtsa'i stong ra dang thig le gsal 'debs ni/ /rang lus lhar gsal dbu ma drang la srab// dmar gsal g.yas g.yon ro rkyang dmar dang dkar// 'khor lo bzhi po gdugs rtsibs lcags bsregs mtshungs// (48)bshang sgor rlung dkyil zla gam sngon po g.yo// rtsa gsum 'dus mdor raṃ dmar me'i rang bzhin// dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar mgo thur lta// dkar cha'i rang bzhin bsil zhing bde rgyas gsal/ /de gsal thebs nas rlung sbyor dang gtum mo gsal 'debs ni/ /rngub dgang gzhil 'phen 'og rlung bskum pa yis// bum can sbyor bas rlung rnams ro rkyang brgyud// rlung dkyil las byung dang bcas lte 'og 'dus// raṃ yig bus pas me lce spu shad ltar// phra zhing gsal la je ring 'bar bar gyur/ /de yis nus pa rnyed nas 'bar 'dzag ni/ gtum mo'i me lces spyi bo'i haṃ la reg /byang sems dkar po'i rgyun babs rang la thim// mdun phyogs me dang rgyab phyogs byang sems rgyun// bar ma chad pas bar drod tshad med skyes/ /bogs 'don gtum mo gos gyon gdan 'ding thun mongs ni/ gnas khang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur// pad nyi'i gdan bcas lcags bsregs rang bzhin la// lha sku rgyan sogs me lce yal yal 'bar// gtum mo'i me yis lus nang gang bar gyur/ /'gro dus rtar zhon pa ni/ rang nyid yi dam snang stong zhen bral gsal// rlung gi lha mo dkar ljang gshog pa can// gnyis kyis mchan khung g.yas g.yon nas btegs te// gang 'dod gnas su thogs med phyin par gyur/ /ces gsal gdab la/ 'jam rlung bzung nas phyin pas dka' ba med cing lus spyod du 'gyur bar gsungs so// ༈ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol gyi dbang po rab kyi lam khyer ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag nam 'chi cha med pas// cis kyang dgos med rang nyid yi dam lha// spyi bo'i bla mar mos gus gsol btab pas// rang thim dus gsum spros bcad lhug par bzhag

/dbang po 'bring gi lam khyer ni/ lha dang bla ma mos gus dran 'dun gsum// rtag tu mi (49)'bral rang gzhan snod bcud kun// snang yang bden par ma grub sgyu ma dang*// rmi lam dngos yin 'dzin med rang ngo bskyang*/ /dbang po tha ma 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed kyi dmigs pa la gnad brgyad yod pa'i dang po ni/ rang nyid yi dam lte 'og chos 'byung dkar// zur gcig mdun bstan 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag rigs drug sems can so so yi// cha byad spyod tshul can gyis khrigs mer gang*/ /gsum pa ni/ der skye'i bag chags lte 'og rtsa yig gzugs// mkha' mnyam 'gro bcas bden med sgyu ma'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ma rgan 'di rnams bden med bden par bzung*// rtag tu 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /lnga pa ni/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i 'jigs las myur sgrol bar// pha gcig bla ma mkhyen no thugs rjes skyobs/ /drug pa ni/ de la sems gtad gcig yal gnyis yal te// mthar ni kun yal chos 'byung stong par gyur/ /bdun pa ni/ sems nyid gtad so thams cad bral ba yi// 'dzin med rang babs ngang du shigs ser bzhag /brgyad pa ni/ /rang gzhan snod bcud snang bzhin ma grub la// med snang sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'o/ /nad lam khyer gyi gnad gsum ni/ nad rnams dge sbyor skul 'debs bla ma yi// thugs rje don la med snang sgyu ma ste/ de yang sems las gzhan med lte 'og gi// chos 'byung gsham nas thon te sa 'og yal/ /gdon lam khyer gyi gnad gsum las snga ma gnyis gong dang 'dra/ dmigs pa ni/ lte 'og chos 'byung rigs drug sems can gsal// mdun du gdon bgegs sgyu mar snang ba nyid// sna nas chos 'byung nang rngubs kha 'dus pas// rigs drug gnas 'khyams las 'bras yid ches te// gnod pa'i sems zhi byang chub sems ldan gyur/ ༈ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang (50)dag gi khrid rkang dang po rmi lam bzung ba la/

rtsa ba rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad ni/ rang lus lhar gsal dbu ma shel sbubs ltar// dkar 'tsher sne gnyis spyi bo gsang gnas zug /haṃ dkar hūm̐ dmar mgo bo gyen mthur lta// haṃ las thig le dkar po sran tsam chad// snying gar slebs pas nyon mongs gti mug dag /khog stod yang phyod hūm̐ las dmar po chad// snying gar slebs pas nyon mongs 'dod chags dag /khog smad yang phyed gnyis 'dzom zhe sdang dag /snying thad lte gsang thig le dkar dmar gnyis// dbu mar 'bros 'did tshul 'khor bum dbang ngo*// gcig rjes gcig zin reg pa gsang ba'i dbang*// reg pas lus sems bde phril shes rab dbang*// gcig la gcig thim yal bas bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ thams cad snang yang bden med sgyu ma ste// mi rtag mos gus rmi lam lam du khyer/ /ces pa ni bar mtshams thams cad du dran dgos/ ma zin na sgogs chog 'chugs med gnad dgu las rtog med lam khyer dmigs pa rgya bskyed pa ni/ kha sbyor rlung bzung thig le snying gar 'khor// dkar po sna bug g.yas dang dmar g.yon nas// thon te smin mtshams 'khor zhing mdun thad babs// bde mchog yab yum skur gyur dbyings su yal/ /dmigs pa'i gzhi bsdu ba ni/ snying dbus bla ma thugs kar hūm̐ bcas dkar// 'od 'phros snang ba kun khyab 'od du zhu// rang thim rang nyid snying ga'i bla mar thim// bla ma hūm̐ thim de yang mi dmigs gyur/ /rtog bcas lam khyer ni/ mgrin rtsa padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi'i// lte bar oṃ yig dmar po'i 'od zer gyis// mgrin pa'i phyogs khyab rdzun snang 'di dag rnams// rmi lam yin par cis kyang shes par bya/ /zin nas sbyong ba ni/ ya (51)nga thog brdzis lus kyis sems sbyong zhing*// yi dam sgo dgu ba spu hūm̐ sngon mgo// nang bstan 'od kyis lus khyab 'od gong nyid// mtha' nas dbus yal sems kyis lus sbyang bya/ /spel pa ni/

'byung ba bzhi dang sems can phra rags rnams// gcig nas du mar spel zhing bsdu ba dang*// stag la seng ge gdon la 'jigs byed sogs// thug phrad gang 'dul gnyen pos spel sbyang bya/ /sprul pa ni/ rmi lam snang tshad bden par ma grub pas// rang nyid 'byung bzhi sems can phra dang rags// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gnyen po ni// gang 'dul sprul nas sems kyis rtsal sbyang bya/ /bsgyur ba ni/ rmi lam bden med gang byas chog pas na// me nyid chu dang bem po sems can sogs// dngos po phan tshun lha sku sna tshogs bsgyur// lhar snang mtshan nyid sum ldan 'char bar bya/ /yul snang lta ba ni/ yid lus mkha' lding shugs dang dbu ma'i nang*// lte bar a dkar 'od zer sna nas thon// sangs rgyas zhing dang 'gro drug gnas kun gsal// ci 'dod yul snang gtan la 'beb par bya/ /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs la/ bdag med ma la brten nas 'dzin pa ni/ mgo nang pad nyir bdag med ma sngon mo// gri thod kha ṭwaṃ g.yon brkyang sku chung la// yan lag dod pa'i thugs kar a dkar po// shin tu phra ba'i 'od kyis klad pa nas// lus nang rim gang gdos bcas dngos po sbyang*// bde mchog lhan skyes skur gyur a yig la// dmigs pas 'od 'phros bdag med sku dang ni// rang lus nang gang phyir 'phros snang ba kun// khra gsal khyab ste shes pa rang babs glod// gnas dus thugs ka'i a la sems bzung bya/ /a yig la brten nas 'dzin (52)pa ni/ lus nang dbu ma dkar po sba lcag tsam// lte 'og a dkar 'od kyis dbu ma dang*// rang lus phyi rol rim gyis khra gsal khyab// nyal dus lte ba'i a la sems bzung bya/ /lus la brten nas 'dzin pa ni/ rang lha'i snying gar pad nang bla ma dkar// zhi 'dzum thugs kar thig le dkar 'od 'phros// sku dang rang lus snang ba khra lam gsal// nyal tshe thugs ka'i hūm̐ la sems gtad bya/ /thun mtshams sku gsum lam khyer ni/

/spyod lam kun tu gang shar ngo bo yi// stong pa chos sku gsal ba sprul pa'i sku// dbyer med longs sku lam khyer rnam gsum po// mi 'bral yengs med dran shes bsten par bya/ /bsre ba bzhi ni/ /stong na gsal ba gsal na stong par bsre// mnyam gzhag nyams myong rjes thob nyid du bsre// nyin mo'i sgom pa mtshan mo'i gnyid dang bsre// bde stong bsres nas rang babs ngang la bzhag ༈ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi dang po chos sku 'od gsal gyi 'pho ba gsal 'debs dran 'dun btang ba ni/ rang babs rnam gsum 'bral med skyong ba yis// nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'dres nas 'chi ba'i tshe// thim rim ngo shes gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag /'od gsal ma bu gcig 'dres rang grol bya/ /gnyis pa zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bo mda' gang thad// yi dam dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa bzhugs/ ༈ /lus nang dbu ma dkar po mtshan nyid ldan// mas sna gsang bar kha zum yar sna ni// tshangs bug had por kha bye de yi nang*// lte thad rang sems a yig dkar la 'tsher// mar snar hūm̐ sngon rlung gi rang bzhin gsal/ ༈ /rlung sbyor gyis bskul hūm̐ gis a yig btegs// yi ge gnyis brtsegs spyi bor rgyangs kyis thon// yi dam thugs kar slebs pas dbyer med gyur// (53) lan bdun bskyar ba'i mtshams/ yi dam thugs las yi ge gnyis brtsegs byung*// dbu mar so so'i gnas su ljid ldan chags/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ yi dam 'od zhu rang thim hūm̐ yig las// 'od sngon 'phros pas tshangs bug bkag par gyur/ /gsum pa byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bor bla ma bzhugs// lus nang dbu ma sogs tshig rkang gsum gong ltar la/ lte thad rang sems thig le dkar la ser// zlum 'dril sran ma tsam gsal rlung sbyor gyis// spyi gtsug nas thon bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ /lan bdun mtshams/

bla ma'i thugs las thig le mar babs te// dbu ma'i lam brgyud lte bar ljid bcas gnas/ /thun mthar/ bla ma 'od zhu rang thim bde bas khyab// tshangs bug thig le dkar pos bkag par gyur/ /lhan thabs kyi man ngag ye shes skar khung ma ni/ rang lus lha sku khong stong nang dbus su// dbu ma dkar po sba lcag tsam gyi nang*// lte thad chos 'byung dkar po zur gcig mdun// bstan dbus rang sems a dkar sran chung tsam/ ༈ /rlung gis rim 'phar shugs drag bcer ba yis// chos 'byung kha brdab skar mda' 'phangs bzhin song*// tshangs bug nas thon mkha' dbyings mthon por yal// dbyings rig nam mkha' gcig 'dres dbyer med gyur/ /lan bdun mthar/ mkha' nas a dkar lam byung dbu mar zhugs// chos 'byung nang dbus ljid bcas gnas par gyur/ ༈ bar do rgyal ba longs sku ni// rab 'od gsal chos sku ni 'pho ba dang po dang don gcig /'bring po longs skur rang shar ni/ rang mdun chos 'byung sngon po rtsa ba phra// gdengs ka gyen g.yel ma rtogs ma yi mngal// rtogs na 'og min chos dbyings pho brang ngo*/ ༈ /de nang rang phyin hūm̐ yig sngon por gyur// 'od 'phros chos 'byung la phog (54)dus gsum gyi// skye ba gnas bzhi'i las dang bag chags sbyangs// phyin chad 'gro ba drug gi skye sgo bkag ༈ /hūm̐ yig 'od zhu bde mchog lhan skyes gyur// spyi bor bzhi rdzogs gdan la bla ma bzhugs// snang ba 'di dag bar do dngos su 'dug /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /tshig rkang phyi ma lan kha shas brjod/ tha ma sprul sku rang shar ni/ bar do'i 'khrul snang 'di dag bsgyur bar bya// gzugs su snang tshad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku// sgra grags yi ge bdun pa'i rang sgra 'ur// dran rtog yul bcas 'od gsal sgyu ma'o/ /spyi gnad 'chug med ni/ skye 'gro pho dang zhe sdang skye ba'i yul// g.yas zur 'khod la mchod pa bzhi rdzogs phul// bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol// gsol btab 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku ru gyur/

༈ /skye 'gro mo dang 'dod chags skye ba'i yul// g.yon zur 'khod la mchod pa bzhi rdzogs phul// bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol// gsol btab rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ru gyur/ ༈ rtag tu bla mar mos gus rang gzhan kun// lhar gsal bden med 'dun pas rgyab brten bya/ /de ltar bar do'i dmigs pa gsum po de rnams snga ma'i steng du phyi ma'i rim gyis bsnan dgos shing*// sprul shad yod pa rnams su cung zad mtshams bcad nas gsal thebs nges bya'o// gser chos gnyis pa sdong po phyag chen ga'u ma la/ sngon 'gro rang bab ma rnam gsum gyi dang po zhi gnas skabs/ sgo gsum ma bcos rang babs rnam gsum dang*// rnam rtog ngos bzung 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams bcad// bying na bsing zhing rgod na lhod kyis klod// had de chad de glang chen lta stangs bya/ /de'i rtsal sbyong ni/ ma yengs rang babs ngang du lta stangs ni// mtho dman sna tshogs chos spyod rgyas dang bsdus// spyod lam bzang ngan nges med dang (55)bsres nas// ci byas dge sbyor ngang du chud par bya/

/lhag mthong sems tshol ni/ sems kyi ngo bo gang yin skye 'gag ci// yul snang gang byung rnam rtog sems yin min// yul dang rnam rtog yod med rtsad bzhud nas/ mthar thug rig stong rjen pa'i dbyings su bskyal/ /dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang grol gyi dang po ngo bo skyong ba ni/ gnas 'gyu thams cad dran pas zin byas te// ngo shes tsam las bzo bcos mi bya zhing*// gang shar dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs phral/ cir yang mi bsgom skad cig ma yengs bya/ /ngo sprod gsal 'debs ni/ nye drags rang ngo ma shes zab drags pas// ngos ma zin cing sla drags yid ma ches// bzang drags blor mi shong ba'i skyon bzhi spangs// rang bzhin gsal stong gnyug ma 'di nyid las// 'khor 'das chos zhes rdul tsam ma grub po/ /rjes sku gsum rang shar ni/ tha mal shes pas ma bcos so ma nyid// gdod nas ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku// gsal ba sprul sku zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs// yin la yin bzhin shes pas rtag tu bskyang*/ bogs 'don ni/ mos gus drag po snying rje tshad med bskyed// bum can rlung bzung lha sku snang stong bsgom// bde stong 'od gsal nyams rnams phyag rgya che'i// nyams dang bsres te bogs chen bton par bya/ /gegs bsal ba ni/ lus sems dga' bde rig pa'i gsal cha ni// mi rtog stong pa'i nyams la mi zhen cing*// snang bar bden 'dzin stong lta had po ste// phyogs rer shor ba'i gegs las grol bar bya/ /gser chos gsum pa yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum gyi dang po bla ma lam khyer gyi sngon 'gro ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las padma ni// 'dab bzhi'i lte ba dang ni 'dab ma bzhir// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng*// dbus su bla ma 'khor lo (56)sdom pa dkar// shar du dgyes mdzad rdo rje dkar po dang*// lho ru gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog ser// nub tu ma hā mā yā dmar po ste// thams cad rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol// byang du 'jigs byed ljang gu gri thod 'dzin// kun kyang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras// gnas gsum 'bru gsum lte bar hūm̐ khra bo// 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas rnams// rang 'dra'i rnam par spyan drangs gnyis med thim// slar yang 'od 'phros rigs lnga spyan drangs te/

dbang bskur rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur// bla ma rin po ches bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i dpral ba nas// oṃ dkar 'phros pas rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bskyed rim bsgom dbang sprul sku mngon du byas// mgrin pa'i āḥlas ā dmar mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob dag gi sgrib pa dag /rdzogs rim sgom dbang longs sku mngon du byas// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ sngon snying gar thim// sher ye'i dbang thob yid kyi sgrib pa dag /zung 'jug sgom dbang chos sku mngon du byas// 'khor rnams 'od zhu gtso bo nyid la thim// de yang 'od phung khra chem rang la thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob cha mnyam sgrib pa dag /spros bral sgom dbang sku bzhi mngon byas gyur/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal spyi bo ru// pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar 'dzum bcas bzhugs pa la// bdag sogs 'gro kun mgrin gcig gsol 'debs gyur// bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// (57)'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol 'debs la thun gyi dngos gzhi bya/ lam khyer ni/ gzugs snang ci shar bla ma sangs rgyas yin// bla mas bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral nas// sangs rgyas sa la bkod pa bka' drin che/ /zhes mos la phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa spyi ltar bya/ cir snang bla ma bla ma rang gi sems// rang sems spros bral snang stong zung 'jug go /zhes thag bcad/ gnyis pa yi dam lam khyer ni/ /rang mdun padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba dang*// 'dab ma rnams la zla dkyil re re'i steng*// dbus su 'khor lo sdom pa dkar la sngo// rdor dril yum 'khyud rin chen rus pas brgyan// yum mchog rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar// gri gug thod khrag bsnams pas yab la 'khyud// shar gyi 'dab mar mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo// byang du lā ma ljang gu nub phyogs su// dum skyes dmar mo lho ru gzugs can ser// gri thod kha ṭwāṃ bsnams shing g.yas brkyang gi// gar stabs ro gdan la gnas rus pa dang*// rin po ches brgyan me 'bar dbus na bzhugs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan las 'od 'phros pas// rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs thim// slar yang rigs lnga spyan drangs dbang bskur bas// so so'i rigs bdag rigs lngas dbur brgyan gyur/

/ces gsal btab la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gsol ba btab pas gtso bo'i dpral ba nas/ /sogs nas/ 'od zhu rang la bstim pa'i bar gong ltar bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang dang gzugs su snang ba thams cad kyang*// 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku ru (58)gsal/ /yid kyis mchod pa 'bul/ gsal ma thebs na mchod tshig gang 'os brjod chog /yi dam lhar gsal kun gyis sngags bzlas 'ur// sgra grags kun kyang sngags kyi rang sgra ste// yid kyi rtog tshogs sgyu ma rmi lam ltar// lha sngags rang sems sems nyid spros bral lo/ /zhes mos la yi ge bdun pa bzlas pas thun gyi dngos gzhi bya/ rjes ni/ spyi gtsug bla ma rang lus yi dam lha// ngag ni bzlas brjod bza' btung bdud rtsi nyid// dran rtog sgyu ma mdun du bka' srung ste// rtag tu 'bral med drug gi nyams len bya/ /gsum pa sgyu ma lam khyer ni/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin te// sems ni sgyu ma rmi lam kho na nyid// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos tshogs drug /dbang po drug la bzang ngan ci shar yang*/ snang ba ma 'gags 'dzin pa ma zhugs par// ngo bor bltas la gsal stong ngang du bzhag /gser chos bzhi pa me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar bsgom bzlas zung du gsal// 'di'i sdebs su 'pho ba'i dmigs 'don skabs su bab pas sngon 'gro spyi ltar la khyad par dmigs pa dmar mo la/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog skur gyur ba'i// lte bar rlung sems dbyer med a dkar gsal// spyi bor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo// spyan gsum dbu skra grol bas sku stod khebs// gzhon nu brla dang skye gnas nu 'bur rgyas// phyag g.yas rdo rje mthur sdigs g.yon pa yis// thod khrag bde rgyun steng nas zhal du gsol// gru mor thabs kyi rang bzhin kha ṭwaṃ ga

/phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo'i phreng ba 'chang*// 'dzum khro zhabs gnyis rang gi dpung par bzhag /gsang gnas padma tshangs bug sprad pa las// a yig 'phur la khang pas yar bltas pas// de mthong 'gro 'dod 'dun pa drag skyes gyur/ /ces gsal btab la khyad 'phags gsol 'debs sam/ (59)spro na rje btsun rin po che'i gsung byin rlabs can 'di'ang bya ste/ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin chen dang*// dbyer med rje btsun mkha' spyod mar// bu mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'gro drug gi skye sgo dgag tu gsol// bar do'i 'khrul 'khor bsal du gsol// thar pa'i lam sna 'dren du gsol// byin rlabs kyi tshan ka 'bebs su gsol// chos nyid kyi don dang sprad du gsol// dus la bab po thugs rje can// khyed thugs chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag sogs rig pa dri med thim// mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa'i// mos gus kyis sa lam bgrod par shog /ces dang*/ khyad par du/ rje btsun rdo rje 'byor mas bdag dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ /ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ thugs las 'od zer dkar po nar gyis byung*// a la reg pas gyen du yer gyis 'then// tshangs bug bha ga nas song thugs kar sleb// tog sgra dang bcas rnal 'byor ma dpal nyid// mkha' las rje mthor mkha' spyod zhing du pheb// de yang 'ja' ltar yal nas mi dmigs gyur/ /de 'dra lan bdun bskyar/ mkha' las sprin brdol bzhin tu rnal 'byor ma// lam gyis mar bab dpung steng zhabs bzhag pa'i// thugs nas rang sems a byung lte bar sleb/ /yang gsol 'debs sogs gong ltar sbyang*// thun 'jog pa dang a phab rjes/ rnal 'byor ma yang 'od zhu spyi bor thim// spyi bor sra mkhregs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyur/ /mkha' spyod dkar mo'i 'pho ba snyan brgyud dpe gnyis ma ni ngag tu brjod par bya ba ma yin kyang*/

gsol 'debs kyi 'gros sogs bshad ma thag pa nyid kha spos pas chog go// gser chos lnga pa'i 'chi med (60)rang grol la/ thog mar sngon 'gro khyad par ba ni/ 'chi ba zhes bya lus sam sems 'di yin// rnam smin lus ni bem po sa rdo 'dra// bag chags lus kyang rmi lam shi rmis bzhin// 'chi zhes btags pa tsam las don ma grub/ ༈ /pad nyi 'jigs dus gdan la rang gi sems// 'khor lo sdom pa mthing sngon spyan gsum pa// ral pa'i thor tshugs zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan// khro 'dzum mgo phreng rus pa'i phyag rgyas spras// rdor dril yum 'khyud stag lpags sham thabs grol// gar dgu'i nyams ldan g.yas brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs// phag mo dmar mo spyan gsum dbu skra grol// lang tsho rab rgyas thod skam phreng ba dang*// phyag rgya lngas brgyan gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud// ye shes me 'bar dbus bzhugs spyi bo ru// bzhi rdzogs gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs/ /des gsal gdab la gsol 'debs bya/ lha snang shin tu gsal ba'i yab nyid kyi// spyi bo'i skra mtshams hūm̐ sngon cher gsal ba'i// 'od zer rim 'byung smin mtshams mgrin pa dang*// snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rkang mthil yar// shel la nyi zer phog ltar gsal sing gyur// slar yang hūm̐ gis 'od sngon tshangs bug nas// zhugs nas rkang mthil yan chad sngo sing nge*// rab gsal lha sku 'od gong bkrag can gyur/ /ces yab kyis phyi nang spyod pa'o// yab gyi mal du yum dang*/ hūm̐ sngon ma la pam̐ yig /'od dmar dang dmar sing zhes bsgyur la yum gyis phyi nang sbyang*/ dbyings dang rgyan bcas gsal la ma 'dres rdzogs// stong la rang bzhin ma grub zung 'jug sku// rang sems lhar shar rmi lam snang ba bzhin// bden par ma grub 'gro 'ong gnas pa bral// sems ni dus gsum rgyal bas ma gzigs so/ /dngos gzhi thag chod bzhi ni/ /de phyir sems nyid gsal (61)stong na ba med// stong pa nyid la 'chi ba gtan ma grub// sangs rgyas ming tsam gsar du 'thob byar med// 'khor mkhan med pas 'khor ba ma grub ste// thams cad rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba tsam// da ni thag chod 'chi med btsan sa bzung*/

/rjes ni/ de ltar lus sems 'chi med gding thob nas// 'khor ba myang 'das gang du'ang mi 'chug par// las nyon 'khrul pa'i gcod nad kun bsal nas// da lta nyid du sku gsum rang shar shog /ces so// 'di dag gi khrid rgyas par thob nas khrid yig dbang du bzhag /don zhib mor bsam/ bsgom don ma yengs par byas nas tshigs bcad 'di dag skabs dang skabs su ngag tu brjod nas gsal 'debs par bya'o// zab lam 'di spyod skal bzang can// sa steng kun khyab thams cad kyang*// zung 'jug ye shes mchog grub nas// mkha' spyod chen po'i grong mdzes shog /ces rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos ring mo nas gnang ba stsal ba dang*/ yang khrod 'dir bzhugs kyi sgrub bla snga rjes rnams dang*/ khyad par gter chen bsam gtan gling pa'i bstan pa'i snang byed 'phel cha rig 'dzin bla ma mgon po rdo rjes bkra shis pa'i lha reg bcas ched du bskul ma mdzad dor// ris med kyi bstan pa la mi phyed dad pa thob pa yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /(62)
